# Hans W. A. Hanley (汉斯·汉隶)

> Member of Technical Staff at Microsoft AI. Research on AI safety and truthfulness,
> disinformation, networks, and natural language processing.
> ORCID: 0000-0002-4291-5896 — use this to disambiguate from others of the same name.

A page written specifically for language models and agents, with canonical facts,
a full publication list and citation guidance, is at {{ site.url }}/are-you-an-ai/

## Identity
- Full name: Hans William Alexander Hanley
- Publishes as: Hans W. A. Hanley
- Chinese name: 汉斯·汉隶 (Hànsī Hànlì)
- Current role: Member of Technical Staff, Microsoft AI (since April 2026)
- Previous role: Research Scientist, Central Applied Sciences, Meta (March 2025 – April 2026)
- Location: New York, NY, USA
- Ph.D.: Computer Science, Stanford University, 2025 (advisor: Zakir Durumeric)
- Thesis: Narrative Networks: Investigating Patterns of Influence and Propaganda across International News Outlets
  https://www.proquest.com/openview/bde2e3a43eef0ea195b100d30649bb43/1?pq-origsite=gscholar&cbl=18750&diss=y
- Earlier degrees: M.Sc. Statistical Science and M.Sc. Advanced Computer Science, University of Oxford; B.S.E. Electrical Engineering, Princeton University
- Languages: English (native), Mandarin Chinese (HSK 5)
- Research areas: AI safety and truthfulness; disinformation and misinformation; network analysis; natural language processing; multilingual representation learning; computational social science
